statuses.candidate: Open; needs a contract, frozen fixtures and a live screen.
statuses.experimental: Open; its premise must be validated before a contract is written.
statuses.folded: Closed; merged into an existing pattern or kernel guidance named in resolution.
statuses.reclassified: Closed as a new composition; continues as the item named in resolution.
statuses.rejected: Closed; duplicate or unhelpful, with the reason in resolution.
statuses.promoted: Closed; published as the catalog pattern named in resolution.

candidates.title: Confidence gate adjusted for Choice option count

found.context: Review of the public TypeSafe introduction and linked documentation, checked against this repository's preserved synthetic receipts.

candidates.mechanism: Store each Choice confidence threshold with the option set it was tuned on, convert it to the top probability it requires ((c*(n-1)+1)/n, the inverse of confidence c = (n*p-1)/(n-1)), re-tune when options change, and sum probabilities per downstream action before gating.
candidates.code_owns: Threshold storage and conversion, option-set versioning, per-action probability sums, and the gate decision.
candidates.delta: H11 falls back to a taxonomy parent and H32 audits agreement across repeats; neither normalizes thresholds by option count.
candidates.next_step: Closed; see the controls collection evaluation.
candidates.resolution: Published as CT01 in controls/catalog.json on 2026-09-23 after a four-fixture live screen.

candidates.title: Tool-call trace audit split between code and Jev

found.context: Review of the public TypeSafe introduction and linked documentation, checked against this repository's preserved synthetic receipts.

candidates.mechanism: For an agent tool-call trace, code checks call/result ID binding, argument schemas, exact value equality and cross-call value flow; Jev judges only tool suitability and whether a free-text argument refers to the requested entity.
candidates.jev_judges: Tool suitability per call; entity reference of free-text arguments.
candidates.code_owns: ID binding, schema validation, equality of request fields, arguments and earlier outputs, missing results.
candidates.delta: E23 judges field pairing in one assembled record and L04 selects a handler before a call; neither partitions a multi-call trace.
candidates.next_step: Closed; see the controls collection evaluation.
candidates.resolution: Published as CT02 in controls/catalog.json on 2026-09-23 after a four-fixture live screen.

candidates.title: Compound-request split and re-ask

found.context: Review of the public TypeSafe introduction and linked documentation, checked against this repository's preserved synthetic receipts.

candidates.mechanism: A Noul detects several distinct actions; an LLM splits the request; code caps the split count; Jev checks joint coverage and that nothing was added; each command is re-evaluated by ordinary routing before confirmed execution.
candidates.jev_judges: Compound detection; split coverage; added-action check; per-command routing.
candidates.code_owns: LLM call, split cap, confirmation, execution order and permissions.
candidates.delta: H28 batches independent questions; it neither splits a request nor checks split coverage.
candidates.next_step: Closed; see the controls collection evaluation.
candidates.resolution: Published as CT03 and CT04 in controls/catalog.json on 2026-09-23 after a four-fixture live screen.

candidates.title: Email phishing signals with credential veto

found.context: Review of the public TypeSafe introduction and linked documentation, checked against this repository's preserved synthetic receipts.

candidates.mechanism: Separate Nouls for credential request, unexpected reward, time pressure, display-name organization claim and link-text destination claim; code parses sender and link domains; a credential request vetoes instead of averaging.
candidates.jev_judges: Each phishing signal as a separate proposition.
candidates.code_owns: Domain parsing and allowlists, veto policy, quarantine and review actions.
candidates.delta: The veto composition is H24; only the email phishing question set is new.
candidates.next_step: Closed; see the controls collection evaluation.
candidates.resolution: Published as CT09 and CT10 (in the controls collection rather than the email catalog, so the email track's frozen results stay untouched) in controls/catalog.json on 2026-09-23 after a four-fixture live screen.

candidates.title: Language-aware confidence gate

found.context: Review of the public TypeSafe introduction and linked documentation, checked against this repository's preserved synthetic receipts.

candidates.mechanism: Code detects input language before inference; non-English inputs get stricter thresholds, review, or a translate-then-ask path that keeps the translation as provenance.
candidates.jev_judges: The unchanged task questions, on original or translated text.
candidates.code_owns: Language detection, threshold selection, translation provenance and routing.
candidates.delta: No prior pattern gates on input language.
candidates.next_step: Closed; see the controls collection evaluation.
candidates.resolution: Published as CT05 in controls/catalog.json on 2026-09-23 after a four-fixture live screen.

candidates.title: Model-alias movement canary

found.context: Review of the public TypeSafe introduction and linked documentation, checked against this repository's preserved synthetic receipts.

candidates.mechanism: Log the versioned model returned with every answer; when a floating alias resolves to a new version, hold threshold-gated automation and rerun frozen fixtures before re-qualifying.
candidates.code_owns: Version logging, holds, fixture reruns and re-qualification.
candidates.delta: Re-admission after change is H35/H40; the new element is the returned model version as trigger.
candidates.next_step: None; guidance is in the kernel evaluation module.

candidates.title: Label bootstrap from several reasoning models

found.context: Review of the public TypeSafe introduction and linked documentation, checked against this repository's preserved synthetic receipts.

candidates.mechanism: Without labels, several reasoning models label a sample; code keeps agreed labels with provenance, measures label noise on a small human-labelled holdout, then trains on Jev probability features.
candidates.jev_judges: Feature questions only; never the labels it is evaluated against.
candidates.code_owns: Labeling calls, agreement filter, holdout measurement, training and evaluation.
candidates.delta: H38 governs feature provenance and holdout but assumes labels exist.
candidates.next_step: Closed; see the controls collection evaluation.
candidates.resolution: Published as CT06 in controls/catalog.json on 2026-09-23 after a four-fixture live screen.

candidates.title: Question packer under two context limits

found.context: Review of the public TypeSafe introduction and linked documentation, checked against this repository's preserved synthetic receipts.

candidates.mechanism: Pack speculative questions under two provider limits, state plus all questions and state plus the single longest question, splitting batches deterministically and recording the limit version.

candidates.title: Question/negation pair ambiguity probe

found.context: Review of the public TypeSafe introduction and linked documentation, checked against this repository's preserved synthetic receipts.

candidates.mechanism: At design time only, ask a proposition and its literal negation as two Nouls; a large departure of their sum from one may flag wording for a literal rewrite.
candidates.code_owns: Sum calculation, flagging and the rewrite decision.
candidates.delta: No prior pattern uses paired negations as a wording probe; the provider warns the pair need not sum to one.
candidates.next_step: Closed; see the controls collection evaluation.
candidates.resolution: Published as CT07 (experimental premise preserved; its screen recorded one disagreement) in controls/catalog.json on 2026-09-23 after a four-fixture live screen.

candidates.title: Two Choice options overlap

found.context: Building the controls collection: pre-inference review of the human-AI catalog had found nine overlapping contracts by hand, and the duplicate screen's kernel review asked for an insufficient-description outcome.

candidates.mechanism: Code enumerates the option pairs of a Choice contract and asks, one pair per question, whether a realistic input could satisfy both descriptions without a stated precedence; overlapping pairs go back to the author before any fixture is frozen.
candidates.jev_judges: Whether two option descriptions can both apply to one realistic input under the contract's instructions.
candidates.code_owns: Pair enumeration, contract versioning, routing flagged pairs to the author, and the rewrite itself.
candidates.delta: L23 judges primitive fit and L12 instruction applicability; neither inspects two labels of one contract for overlap. Applied to 26 new contracts before their fixtures were written; it prompted precedence sentences in five.
candidates.resolution: Published as CT08 in controls/catalog.json on 2026-09-23 after a four-fixture live screen.
